consultation_result:
In order to clarify claim 1, circa 15.10.16, and to orthogonalize the method clearly from the one known from CA-A- 951201, it is appropriate to specify that the temperature (broadened) curve causing the foaming increase during the length of the extruder barrel to a maximum just before the die within the range of from about 15 to 300 °C. (See the description of the present application page 11, line 22-25). The form of claim 1 should be revised or suggested in the letter dated 12.02.1987.

The description must be brought into conformity with claim 1.
GB-A-105555 should be acknowledged in the description (clauses 27(2)).
The representative asked for a two months limit in order to discuss the above described amendments with the applicant.
